info.title: Wheelchair Velocity API
info.description: API for manual teleoperation and monitoring of wheelchair velocity commands.

get.summary: Get current navigation goal and status
get.description: Retrieves the active goal coordinates, the current ROS status, and real-time feedback.

post.description: Sends a new target pose (x, y, yaw) to the robot.

delete.description: Issues a cancellation command to the Nav2 action server.

409.description: Conflict - No active goal to cancel.

get.description: Returns the metadata and the 1D array of cell data representing the environment.

503.description: Service Unavailable - Map data not yet received from ROS.

get.description: Returns the robot's current x, y coordinates and yaw orientation relative to a specific coordinate frame (usually "map").

503.description: Service Unavailable - Pose data not yet received from the ROS transform tree or topic.

200.description: Room registered. Returns the saved room.
Room updated. Returns the updated single room.

post.description: Sends a nav2 NavigateToPose goal using the room's stored pose.

get.description: Get all devices connected to the network by using UDP broadcast.

parameters.name: timeoutMs
parameters.description: Discovery timeout in milliseconds (clamped between 1-9999, default 400).

200.description: Device registered. Returns the registered device.
Device updated. Returns the updated single device.
Device state changed. Returns the updated device.

get.summary: Get device info from device hardware
get.description: Fetches live info directly from the physical device over HTTP.

200.description: Device info retrieved. Shape depends on the physical device response.
Device room changed. Returns TypeORM UpdateResult.

get.description: Retrieves the last commanded linear and angular velocity inputs for the wheelchair.

post.description: Publishes new linear and angular velocity commands to the wheelchair.

200.description: Velocity command processed and returned in nested format.

400.description: Invalid Input - Values must be numbers between -1 and 1.

message.example: Linear and angular values must be numbers between -1 and 1.

width.description: Number of cells in the x direction.

height.description: Number of cells in the y direction.

map.description: 1D array of occupancy values (0-100, -1 for unknown).

Room.description: Room object as stored in DB and kept in memory.

RoomsMap.description: Object keyed by room id, each value is a Room.

RegisterRoomRequest.description: Request body uses camelCase field names per the DTO validation.

UpdateRoomRequest.description: All fields optional except id. Uses camelCase per the DTO.

Device.description: In-memory device object (merged from DB + discovery data).

DevicesMap.description: Object keyed by device id, each value is a Device.

data.description: Shape depends on the physical device response.

state.description: For binary controlType, must be 0 or 1.

roomName.description: Optional room name to associate the device with on registration.
